dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Communications in progress across your organisation, by stage.

empty.title: No communications yet
empty.description: Source upload and generation arrive in batch 1. The foundations — tokens, themes, components, languages — are in place.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested address does not match any page. Check the link or return to the dashboard.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: The application could not display this page. No data was changed. You can try again.

design.title: Design system
design.description: ComGen's foundations and components, in their real state. This page is the visual reference and the accessibility test bench.

colors.title: Colours
colors.intro: One accent hue. Every other colour carries a meaning and nothing else: success, warning, error.

typography.title: Typography
typography.intro: Fixed scale from 14 px. Every size is paired with its line height.
typography.sample: Versions, dates and identifiers are copied, never regenerated.
typography.mono: Identifiers and versions in monospace: INC-2025-0342, v4.2.1

spacing.title: Spacing and shape
spacing.intro: 4 px grid. Deliberately small radii: separation comes from the border, not the shadow.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.intro: A single primary action per view. Destructive actions are always named.

fields.title: Fields
fields.intro: Label above, hint below, error after the hint. A field in error is announced to screen readers.
fields.subjectHint: As it will appear in the sent email.
fields.audienceHint: One list per persona. Recipients are validated at send time.
fields.audienceError: The audience “Tier 2 suppliers” no longer exists in the directory.

badges.title: State badges
badges.intro: Every state has a shape and a text. Colour reinforces, it is never the only signal.

notices.title: Messages
notices.intro: Three levels. The blocking level always explains what is missing and what to do.

info.title: Extraction complete
info.body: 12 facts were extracted from the source. Validate them before generating.

warning.title: Incomplete register
warning.body: The “reassuring” tone has no equivalent for German. The German variant will use the default register.

blocking.title: Sending blocked: 2 assertions without supporting fact
blocking.body: Assertions A-07 and A-11 are not linked to any fact in the fact sheet. Link them to an existing fact or remove them from the variant.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.intro: For parallel views of the same object, never for sequential steps.

table.title: Table
table.intro: Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures. The whole row is clickable; the sorted header is announced.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: Always accompanied by a label and a numeric value.
progress.label: Generating variants

screenStates.emptyDescription: Upload a document, an email or a ticket to extract its facts.
screenStates.errorDescription: The data service did not respond. Your drafts are intact.
